operation.name: OSGB36 to WGS 84 (9)
operation.why: OSTN15-based NTv2 transformation (1 m) covering Britain and UKCS; default PROJ choice for BNG to WGS 84; BNG inverted to OSGB36 geographic first

assumptions: Input eastings/northings are British National Grid (EPSG:27700); inverse Transverse Mercator to OSGB36 (EPSG:4277) then EPSG:7710. Grid fetched from PROJ CDN on demand.
notes: Default PROJ 27700->4326 chooses the same operation (9); OSTN02 op 5339 returned inf in this environment so was not used. Helmert 1314 differs by about 1e-5 deg (~1 m).
